Time to celebrate the Raider! We're releasing a Unique Execution for that Hero.

About For Honor:
Carve a path of destruction through the battlefield fighting for guts, glory, and survival in For Honor. Enter the chaos of a raging war as a Hero from some of the greatest warrior legacies ever known. For Honor is a fast-paced and immersive experience, mixing skill with visceral, never-before-seen melee combat.

Enjoy incredible seasonal content, engaging campaign and thrilling multiplayer with friends online, in split screen two-player co-op, or solo against AI.

author: Ubisoft
description:
Gear up for Year 8! 
 
Black Tusk pressure is mounting, ready to test even the strongest Agents. This season marks the start of a new year of exciting content for The Division, delivering features that raise the challenge to new heights while giving Agents new ways to grow stronger.
 
Packed with challenges, limited-time events, the return of Classified Assignments, and a brand‑new Season Pass, ""Rise Up"" is an action‑packed season that pushes Agents to gear up, take risks, and fight back against Black Tusk. 
 
The Division 2: Rise Up starts on April 2nd.

About The Division 2:
Tom Clancy's The Division 2 is a shooter RPG with a thrilling campaign fully playable in co-op and multiple PVP modes.

In The Division 2, save your country in Washington, DC, and in the Warlords of New York expansion, hunt down Aaron Keener, a former Agent who has taken control of New York.

#Ubisoft #TheDivision2

Learn more about Ubisoft: www.ubisoftgroup.com

Red Bull Faster is back!
Enjoy a FREE week from April 3–10 to compete in the online qualifier.
Take on 3 custom tracks and secure your spot on the global leaderboard before April 19.
A total of eight custom maps await, culminating in the offline finals at Amaze Amsterdam.
Find all the details here: http://redbull.com/faster

About Trackmania:
Experience the thrills of racing and the joy of creating your own tracks with Trackmania®!

Trackmania® combines easy-to-learn, hard-to-master gameplay with a wide diversity of tracks, in addition to regular seasons & live events:

Play in an online multiplayer environment or solo against players' ghosts. Progress through rankings and collectible medals.
Face new challenges with a new season every 3 months and a wide variety of community tracks displayed in the ""Track of the Day"" selection.

#Ubisoft #Trackmania
